changelog: Aura AI v2.2.7 — Live Voice Action Engine Fixes & Real Terminal Execution
Fixed open_app to support name/package arguments and direct package resolution for WhatsApp, YouTube, Chrome, Settings, Camera
Smart Accessibility Tap: locate UI elements by visible text or content description (e.g. contact names like 'Abhishek') and click them directly
Smart Text Injection: automatic focus detection, editable node discovery, and automatic Send button tapping
Added open_aura_app to seamlessly bring Aura AI back to the foreground from other apps
Added execute_terminal_command, write_project_file, and read_project_file to Gemini Live for real coding and localhost execution without hallucination
Hardened Language Guardrails: strictly locks voice conversation to Hindi/Hinglish and ignores ambient background chatter
Voice Session Continuity: automatically records voice session actions into persistent memory
